Team —

We're scoping final AV/network requirements for Acme's executive workshop on Jan 28-29. Can you confirm the following items for the 3rd-floor boardroom + two breakout rooms? Attaching the event brief for context (Acme_Workshop_Brief.docx).

Key asks: 
- Confirm room dimensions and exact projector/screen models for all three rooms (boardroom + two breakouts).
- Audio: console make/model, mic inventory (lapel, handheld, boundary), number of available inputs. Any in-room Dante/AV-over-IP endpoints?
- Video: available camera models, SDI/NDI outputs, stitch/transcoder options. Is a managed SIP/SFU bridge available on-site?
- Network: VLAN availability, guaranteed egress bandwidth, public IPs for streaming, NAT restrictions. Redwood will need ~50 Mbps egress reserved for live streaming + remote participants. 
- Rack access & power: Is there a tech rack we can access? 20A circuits? Lockbox policy?
- Redundancy: N+1 for encoders/transcoders, failover transcode path.

Timing: we expect to run a full AV test on Jan 27 between 10:00–12:00 PT — can you confirm availability for that window and provide an on-site tech lead contact?

Thanks — we want to lock these in today so Marissa can finalize the gear manifest and we can confirm logistics with Acme.

Diego Fernandez
Events & Field Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi Diego / team —

Thanks for the detailed brief. Quick answers inline and attached our standard AV rider + the 3rd-floor floorplan (GrandHill_AV_Rider_v2.pdf, Venue_floorplan_3rdFloor.png). High-level: we can support your requests but a few items need confirmation so we can stage appropriate kit.

- Room dims / projection: Boardroom A (40x25 ft) has Christie Boxer 4K projector, 14’ screen. Breakouts B/C (16x18 ft) each have Crestron 1080p laser projectors and 110" screens.
- Audio: Yamaha CL5 console available in main rack; inventory includes 2 lavs, 4 handhelds, 6 boundary mics. No native Dante nodes in the room; we can patch a Dante interface in the rack on request.
- Video: PTZOptics cameras (2 in boardroom, 1 in each breakout). We can output SDI and provide NDI via encoder (Teradek if requested). Managed SIP conferencing bridge is available for meetings but for the workshop (simulcast + remote presenters) we recommend bringing your own SFU or using our managed Teradek streaming stack.
- Network: We can provision a dedicated VLAN and reserve up to 200 Mbps egress for your session. Public IPs can be provided; rate-limiting/NAT policies will be shared.
- Rack & power: Dedicated AV rack on 3rd floor with 2x 20A circuits and locked cabinet — we can provide a temporary key-code to your lead during load-in.
- Redundancy: We have a secondary transcode path (backup Teradek plus spare encoder) on standby.

Test window: Jan 27 10:00–12:00 PT works for us. On-site tech lead is Marco Ruiz (marco.ruiz@grandhillhotels.com / +1-415-555-0134).

Please review the attached rider and floorplan; if you want us to stage extra encoders or NDI converters we'll quote that as a line item.

Best,
Isabel Flores
Senior Events Manager
Grand Hill Hotels

Thanks Diego — quick notes after reviewing the rider/floorplan: 

- Gear manifest: We will request Grand Hill to stage 2x Teradek encoders (primary + hot spare), 1x NDI-to-SDI converter, and 2 additional wireless lavs (for panelists). Redwood will bring 1x hardware SFU appliance as primary for the simulcast; if Grand Hill prefers to use their Teradek stack we want them as the secondary failover.
- Network: 200 Mbps egress is fine for baseline, but request they reserve 250 Mbps to account for burst and 2x 1080p remote presenters + livestreaming. Also ensure the VLAN has QoS and no restrictive outbound firewall rules on RTP/UDP ranges 10000-20000.
- Camera outputs: ask venue to provide both SDI and an NDI stream from the main boardroom camera — we need a clean feed for recording + an NDI feed for the onsite stream mixing rig.
- Test day: plan a dry run with full-end-to-end encode (Redwood SFU + remote participant) between 10:00–12:00 on Jan 27; please include Marco in invites.

I'll update the hardware PO and send to procurement once we confirm whether Grand Hill will bill the Teradek staging vs Redwood bringing hardware.
